fields.description: Runtime new benches are created with. sysbox user-namespaces the container so container root is unprivileged on the host; runc does not.
fields.label: Default Bench Runtime

fields.description: Bake a lab's finished site into its image on every build, so a deploy restores the database instead of creating it. Turning it off shortens builds on a disk-constrained host; images that already carry a golden keep restoring from it.
fields.label: Enable Golden Images

fields.description: Restore a bench's site from its lab image's golden dump when the image carries one. Turning it off makes every deploy build the site from scratch, which is how a suspect golden is taken out of service without rebuilding anything.
fields.label: Restore From Golden

fields.description: First two octets of the bench bridge family. Bridge i is <base>.<i*16>.0/20. Changing it renames no existing network.
fields.label: Bench Subnet Base

fields.description: How many bench bridges the family may grow to. Bridges are created lazily, so this is a maximum and not a startup cost.
fields.label: Bench Bridge Count

fields.description: Benches a bridge takes before the next one is preferred. A Linux bridge caps at 1024 ports and three of them are infrastructure.
fields.label: Bench Slots Per Bridge

fields.description: Seconds a container death waits before the listener asks the database about it. Must exceed Stop Grace Seconds: a stop holds its transaction open for the whole grace period, so a bench being stopped on purpose still reads Running until it commits.
fields.label: Bench Event Settle Seconds

fields.description: Whether a new bench container is given a Docker healthcheck that asks its site to answer. Off, a bench reports only whether its container exists, which is what every bench did before this switch. Takes effect at the next container create.
fields.label: Enable Bench Healthcheck

fields.description: Seconds between two probes of a bench's site. Each probe is an exec, so this is also the event stream's noise floor: three events per bench per interval.
fields.label: Bench Health Interval Seconds

fields.description: Seconds one probe waits for the site to answer before it counts as a failure.
fields.label: Bench Health Timeout Seconds

fields.description: Consecutive failed probes before Docker calls a bench unhealthy. With the interval above, this is how long a site may be down before anything says so.
fields.label: Bench Health Retries

fields.description: Seconds after a container starts during which a failed probe does not count. Must exceed the longest deploy: on first boot nothing serves the site until the deploy has created it, and a seven-app site takes over three minutes to build.
fields.label: Bench Health Start Period Seconds

fields.description: Benches one stats poll samples, least recently checked first. Docker's stats endpoint samples twice a second apart, so an unbounded pass over a large fleet cannot finish inside its own minute. 0 removes the bound.
fields.label: Stats Poll Max Benches

fields.description: Seconds between two of Traefik's own probes of a bench. This is a fleet-wide request rate against gunicorn, not a preference: Traefik probes every server on every service, so 100 benches at 10 seconds is 20 full Frappe requests a second.
fields.label: Traefik Health Interval Seconds

fields.description: Seconds one Traefik probe waits before it counts as a failure. A failure ejects the server from routing and the bench answers 503 until a probe succeeds again.
fields.label: Traefik Health Timeout Seconds

fields.description: Docker CPU quota in microseconds (100000 = 1 core)
fields.label: CPU Quota

fields.description: Seconds a container gets to exit on SIGTERM before it is killed. Measured: bench containers never exit on SIGTERM, so this is waited out in full on every stop and is the drain rate.
fields.label: Stop Grace Seconds

fields.description: Master switch for credit metering and enforcement. Off means the feature does not exist: nothing is charged, capped or auto-stopped. Rates live in Credit Settings, Instance Size and Credit Pack.
fields.label: Enable Credits
